title: Fiber Arts & Crafting Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=shelly:status) OR (index=personal sourcetype=ravelry:project)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="shelly:status","primary",sourcetype="ravelry:project","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from shelly:status and ravelry:project to see whether two fiber arts feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `shelly:status` and `ravelry:project` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main fiber arts data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
